name: shell-unwrap
description: Applies shell permission rules to wrapped commands: a Go binary that is the Claude Code, Codex and Cursor hook, with an OpenCode plugin and a Pi extension that call it

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && go vet ./... && go test ./... && bun run build && bun test
scripts.build: go build -trimpath -o dist/hook/shell-unwrap ./cmd/shell-unwrap && bun build src/opencode.ts --target bun --outfile dist/opencode/shell-unwrap.js && bun build src/pi.ts --target node --outfile dist/pi/index.js
